authorities detained the fathers of two dissidents in August, held them in pretrial detention, and released both without trial.","notes":["The excerpt supports refusal to provide or renew documents, but not the broader wording “failed to renew.”"]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0009-R07-E008","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0009-R07-E009","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0009-R07-E010","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0009-R07-E011","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0009-R07-E012","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0009-R07-E013","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"Authorities continued prosecuting women social-media influencers on ill-defined morality charges; in April, an economic court sentenced Salma al-Shimy to two years in prison and an EGP 100,000 fine for charges involving sexually provocative videos and alleged violation of family values through her social-media posts.","notes":["The supplied excerpt supports the influencer prosecutions and Salma al-Shimy sentence, but does not include the male-guardianship or Personal Status Law claim."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0009-R07-E014","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0009-R07-E015","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0009-R07-E016","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"In October, the European Parliament adopted an urgency resolution urging the Egyptian government to end its repression ahead of the presidential elections.","notes":["The supplied excerpt supports the European Parliament resolution but does not include the US military-aid waiver or withholding figures."]}]}
